commands.name: workspace-authenticated-frontier-source
command:
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
BASE = '7223938'
def old(path):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', BASE + ':' + path]).decode()
def current(path):
    return Path(path).read_text(encoding='utf-8')
def exact(pattern, path):
    before = re.search(pattern, old(path), re.S)
    after = re.search(pattern, current(path), re.S)
    assert before is not None and after is not None, path
    assert before.group() == after.group(), path
    print('exact preserved: ' + path + ' / ' + before.group().splitlines()[0])
exact(r'    pub\(crate\) fn matches_archive_input\(.*?\n    }', 'crates/kernel/src/derivation_input.rs')
for name in ['read_publication_frontier_on', 'read_construction_frontier_on']:
    exact(r'pub fn ' + name + r'\(.*?\n}', 'crates/kernel/src/archive.rs')
exact(r'                let declared = if let Some\(supplied\) = supplied_input.take\(\) \{.*?\n                };', 'crates/kernel/src/archive.rs')
for path in ['crates/kerml-semantics/src/producer_worklist/frontier.rs', 'crates/kerml-semantics/tests/unit/publication_frontier.rs', 'crates/kerml-text/src/accepted_self_model_tests.rs']:
    assert old(path) == current(path), path
    print('exact preserved: ' + path)
exact(r'fn strict_frontier_attaches_exact_input_and_rejects_changed_declarations_and_history\(.*?\n}', 'crates/kernel/tests/archive.rs')
assert 'self.iter().eq(other.iter())' in current('crates/kernel/src/shared_map.rs')
print('content equality retained: SharedMap effective ordered iterator')
print('source audit passed; no Rust compilation or semantic execution')
